bagPolicy.summary: Approved bags include clear plastic bags no larger than 12" x 6" x 12", standard 1-gallon disposable zip-top bags, or a small clutch no larger than 4.5" x 6.5". All bags are subject to search.
allowed: clear plastic bags no larger than 12" x 6" x 12"
small clutch no larger than 4.5" x 6.5"
prohibited: Food not dispensed by dome concessions
Bottles, cans, coolers, containers, thermoses, or glass containers
Professional nor Semi Professional Cameras, STILL OR DIGITAL
Go Pro Cameras, iPads or Tablets
Animals or pets (not including service animals)
Any item that could obstruct a guest’s view
Any other item deemed dangerous or inappropriate by management

parking.note: Parking options near The Dome at America’s Center include various garages and lots in downtown St. Louis. Prices and availability may vary, so it's advisable to check in advance or consider public transportation for convenience.

rideshare.note: Passenger(s) drop-off and pickup will be permitted on the west lane of Broadway.

concessions.note: St. Louis offers a vibrant happy hour scene with diverse food and drink specials. Highlights include craft cocktails, seasonal fare, and discounted drinks at venues like Art Bar, Basso, and Big Sky Cafe. Broadway Oyster Bar is noted for its gumbo and live music.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: ADA-accessible public elevators are located at the Broadway Central Entrance (on Broadway Avenue) and Courtyard Entrance (located at 7th Street & Convention Plaza, near Entry A). There are several ADA Accessible parking facilities located near The Dome at America’s Center (“The Dome”).

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Guests who exit The Dome outside the designated smoking areas will not be permitted to re-enter The Dome in accordance with The Dome re-entry policy.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: On show days, the box office opens three hours prior to the ticketed show time and remains open until one hour past the ticketed show time. The box office located at the Broadway Central entrance on the east side of the dome is usually open the week prior to shows and on show days only.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at The Dome at America’s Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
